description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayer Buffer API, specifically testing buffer management, device info retrieval, buffer delay calculations, and interactions with the gstreamer pipeline. It uses Google Test framework and mocks to verify correct behavior of the WebAudioPlayer implementation in various scenarios.

classes.name: RialtoServerWebAudioPlayerBufferApiTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for WebAudioPlayer Buffer API tests, inheriting from WebAudioPlayerTestBase, setting up and tearing down WebAudioPlayer instances.

methods.name: writeBufferFailure
methods.description: Helper method to test writeBuffer failure scenario when called without prior getBufferAvailable.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Test that getDeviceInfo returns correct device info under normal conditions.

methods.name: getDeviceInfoSmallSharedBuffer
methods.description: Test getDeviceInfo behavior when shared memory buffer is too small to fit preferred frames.

methods.name: initialGetBufferAvailable
methods.description: Test initial getBufferAvailable returns maximum frames and default shm info after WebAudioPlayer creation.

methods.name: initialWriteBuffer
methods.description: Test that writeBuffer successfully writes the first buffer after getBufferAvailable.

methods.name: initialGetBufferDelay
methods.description: Test that getBufferDelay returns 0 when no frames are queued.

methods.name: writeBufferWithNoGetBufferAvailable
methods.description: Test that writeBuffer fails if called without a prior getBufferAvailable.

methods.name: multipleWriteBufferWithOneGetBufferAvailableNoStoredData
methods.description: Test that writeBuffer only succeeds once per getBufferAvailable call when no stored data exists.

methods.name: multipleGetBufferAvailableNoStoredData
methods.description: Test that multiple getBufferAvailable calls overwrite previous ones if no writeBuffer is called.

methods.name: fullSharedMemory
methods.description: Test behavior when shared memory is fully utilized, ensuring getBufferAvailable reports no space.

methods.name: writeAllStoredDataAndNoNewData
methods.description: Test that stored data is written to gstreamer but no new data is written if no new frames are available.

methods.name: writeAllStoredDataAndNewData
methods.description: Test that stored data and new data are both written correctly when available.

methods.name: writePartialStoredDataAndNoNewData
methods.description: Test partial write of stored data when not all stored data has been written.

methods.name: writeAllStoredWrappedDataAndNewData
methods.description: Test behavior when stored data wraps around the shared memory buffer and new data is written.

methods.name: writeAllStoredDataAndWrappedNewData
methods.description: Test behavior when both stored data and new data wrap around the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: handleWriteBufferTimerAllData
methods.description: Test that the writeBuffer timer writes all data when triggered.

methods.name: handleWriteBufferTimerPartialData
methods.description: Test that the writeBuffer timer writes partial data and restarts if not all data could be written.

methods.name: getBufferDelayLargeQueuedBytes
methods.description: Test getBufferDelay fails gracefully when queued bytes exceed uint32_t range.

methods.name: getBufferDelayQueuedBytes
methods.description: Test getBufferDelay returns correct delay when data is queued in both shm and gst.
